cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.
